verdict.rationale: dlt can run pipelines locally against a DuckDB destination and switch destinations without changing pipeline code, so you can test away from production warehouses. dltHub also offers a personal Playground workspace for running sample pipelines, and its MCP server exposes read-only SQL queries against the destination dataset. Together these make an isolated test setup workable, but it is assembled from general features rather than a dedicated sandbox capability. Missing for 10: a documented dev/prod environment or profile separation, explicit sandbox isolation guarantees for agent runs, guidance on keeping production credentials out of test runs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
